New trendline: click a pivot dot, then a second — drag its handle to extend either end as far as you like. Highlight wave traces the real price path of one leg in a hot color. Duration box drags out a time window you can duplicate and slide onto other legs to compare how fast they formed. Scroll to zoom, drag with Pan on to shift.
